speaker: client
text: It's cow four one seven in the fresh pen. She calved ten days ago and her milk dropped off this morning. Her front left quarter is hard.

speaker: dvm
text: Temperature is forty point one. Heart rate ninety, resp rate thirty-six. Rumen contractions one per minute, a bit slow.

speaker: dvm
text: Left front quarter is hot, swollen and firm. The milk is watery with clots. The other three quarters look normal.

speaker: dvm
text: I'll take a milk sample from that quarter for culture.

speaker: dvm
text: Ceftiofur, intramammary, one tube in the affected quarter once a day for five days.

speaker: dvm
text: Plus flunixin, two point two milligrams per kilo IV, today only.

speaker: dvm
text: Milk withdrawal for the ceftiofur is three days after the last tube. Meat withdrawal is two days.

speaker: dvm
text: For the flunixin, meat withdrawal is four days and milk is thirty-six hours.

speaker: client
text: We've had three other cases in that pen this month.

speaker: dvm
text: Then let's look at the bedding and post-dip in the fresh pen. Send me the culture results and we'll talk about the herd plan.
